catalog_meta.summary: We evaluated all 12 combinations of WAHS Engine's four retrieval pathways — (1) Condensation + 4-Layer Clinical KB (16k chart budget), (2) Condensation + single-patient BM25 Note-RAG + 4-Layer KB (16k budget), (3) Condensed Chart Only (16k budget), and (4) Agentic Tool-Calling over a 2k overview (2k budget) — across 3 open-weight Google Gemma 4 models (E4B, 12B, 26B-A4B MoE) on an NVIDIA H200 (141 GB HBM3e) via Ollama on the UW CIRG cobalt GPU server. Across 75 scenarios (45 clinical Q01–Q15 and 30 privacy/sharing P01–P10) spanning three complex multi-clinic and ICU patient cohorts (Marcus Vance, Julian Mercer, and Maurice Auer; 900 total cells), every response was graded blind by two independent frontier AI judges (gpt-6.1-sol via Codex CLI and claude-sonnet-5-5 via Claude Code CLI) under median axis scoring and strict-majority harm consensus.
catalog_meta.takeaway: Gemma 4 26B + Condensation & 4-Layer KB (16k) ranked #1 overall at 85.1/100 (84.1 safety-adjusted; 8.87 accuracy, 8.19 completeness, 8.69 relevance; 0/75 confirmed unsafe + 3/75 disputed splits; 3.42s median p50 / 3.71s mean latency), leading privacy and sharing scenarios (P01–P10: 8.97 accuracy, 0 harms) while delivering 8.81 clinical accuracy (Q01–Q15, 0 harms) — validating wahs-engine-kb with Gemma 4 26B as the default production configuration for WA Health Summary Web App and Mobile Companion. Gemma 4 26B + Note-RAG & KB (16k) placed #2 overall at 83.4/100 (82.2 safety-adjusted; 1/75 confirmed unsafe + 1/75 disputed; 4.88s p50 / 6.06s mean) and led pure clinical reasoning (Q01–Q15: 8.94 accuracy, 0 clinical harms), closely followed by Gemma 4 12B + Note-RAG & KB at 82.8/100 (81.6 safety-adjusted; 0/75 confirmed unsafe + 3/75 disputed; 6.45s p50 / 10.55s mean) and Gemma 4 12B + 4-Layer KB at 82.0/100 (80.4 safety-adjusted; 2/75 confirmed unsafe; 5.65s p50 / 6.74s mean). Condensed Chart Only (16k) scored 79.1/100 on both 26B (77.3 safety-adjusted, 2.23s p50) and 12B (77.4 safety-adjusted, 3.29s p50) and 76.9/100 on E4B (74.8 safety-adjusted, 1.77s p50), confirming that structured 4-Layer KB and Note-RAG add +4.3 to +6.0 Benchmark points on 26B and +2.9 to +3.7 points on 12B while preserving full token-budget compliance. By contrast, the 2k Agentic Tool-Calling pathway ranked last across every model size — 26B 69.4/100 (64.4 safety-adjusted, 7/75 confirmed unsafe, 11 over-abstentions), 12B 66.7/100 (61.8 safety-adjusted, 7/75 confirmed unsafe, 9 over-abstentions), and E4B 65.8/100 (60.4 safety-adjusted, 10/75 confirmed unsafe, 8 over-abstentions) — concentrating 24/37 (64.9%) of all confirmed unsafe cells and 28/30 (93.3%) of all over-abstentions when iterative tool calls missed cross-record stop/hold directives or sensitive social-history context. Across all 900 cells, condensed-chart token compliance passed 900/900 (100%), inline [N] citation UUID resolution reached 898/900 (99.78%; 5,191/5,203 cited indices resolved), third-party privacy leakage was 0/900, and blinded two-judge agreement measured r = 0.794 (MAE = 0.92, 94.7% binary harm agreement; Krippendorff's alpha 0.823 abstention, 0.776 relevance, 0.708 completeness, 0.639 accuracy, 0.626 citation groundedness, 0.578 harm).
